summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of DuitKu finance tracker. 17/17 pytest backend tests passed (100%). All critical frontend flows verified: Beranda with donut chart + tabs + period selector, side drawer navigation, Rekening CRUD, Bagan, Kategori grid, Pengaturan, Tambah Transaksi modal with numeric keypad, IDR formatting (Rp123.000), and end-to-end transaction creation reflected on Beranda donut.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Invalid DOM property 'transform-origin' (should be transformOrigin), Animated useNativeDriver not supported on web. All cosmetic warnings, do not break functionality.
Two header-menu-button testIDs exist simultaneously in the DOM because Expo Router drawer layout keeps sibling routes mounted. Tests must use ':visible' filter or .first(). Functional impact: none.

action_items: Optional polish: replace deprecated RN-web style props (shadow*, pointerEvents) and use transformOrigin to silence console warnings.
No functional fixes required – MVP Phase 1 is working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured (~510 lines) and excludes MongoDB _id via projection + _clean helper. Good.
Balance recalculation logic uses initialBalance ledger correctly; PUT /accounts adjusts initialBalance when balance is edited manually, preserving tx-derived deltas.
Account DELETE cascades transactions – verified by test.
All endpoints under /api prefix, env-driven MONGO_URL/DB_NAME, no hardcoded secrets.
Pydantic models validate input on every POST/PUT. Literal['expense','income'] enforces type.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 19 categories (14 expense + 5 income) and 2 accounts (Tunai, Bank) on startup. POST /api/data/reset re-seeds. During tests, a TEST_E-Wallet account was created via UI and a Rp12.300 Makanan expense was added; main agent may want to call /api/data/reset before user demo if a clean slate is desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_duitku_api.py (pytest, JUnit XML). They depend on a public BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. clean_state fixture calls POST /api/data/reset. Frontend has many testIDs documented in the review request; all were found and functional. Two duplicate testIDs may appear (header-menu-button, fab-add-transaction) due to Drawer route siblings — always use :visible or .first().
rca_of_issue: No bugs found that require RCA. All requested backend endpoints and frontend flows behaved as designed. Frontend currency formatting verified: '123' + '000' produces 'Rp123.000' and DEL yields 'Rp12.300' (Indonesian dot-thousands).
